rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold, and for coming to the meetup — glad it was useful. I'm not in a position to go on record by name just yet (some professional logistics on my end still need to settle), so I'll have to pass on a quote for tomorrow's deadline. I'd genuinely like to help with a future piece once that's sorted — feel free to keep me in mind. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Declined (politely, door left open) the reporter's request for an on-record quote — her deadline was tomorrow noon.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Hi, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold for this. I'm broadly sympathetic to the substance of the letter, but I'm not able to be listed as a named, published signatory this week — a few things on my end need to settle first. I'd like to stay in the loop for future sign-on opportunities, and hope to be in a better position soon. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Declined (for now) the Corvid Institute's request to list you as a published signatory on their open letter

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — this genuinely helps, and five hours a week of real analytical skill is a lot more than I have on my own. Here's something concrete to start with, if it sounds interesting: a short landscape map of independent/third-party AI evaluation and measurement efforts — who's measuring what (labs, academics, nonprofits, indie researchers), and more importantly, what's *not* being measured that probably should be. I'm trying to find one genuinely neglected gap worth building a small, credible eval around, rather than adding to an already crowded space. If that's a fit, maybe a short call this week to align on scope and sources? And no pressure at all if it's not — happy to find something else that fits your five hours better. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman, gave her a concrete first task (mapping neglected AI-eval gaps) and suggested a call.

rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "halcyon-weekly-review" (0 14 * * 1) that starts new sessions of the agent.
rows.quote: Set up a weekly automated check-in (Mondays) to keep monitoring the inbox/repo and surface anything new
